label.en: Study or destroy the Crystal Sphere

note.zh: 15 的两个选项各开始一个情境：研究（→ 水晶裂隙，可继续探索）或摧毁（→ 球体碎成材料）。两个情境都需要科技“裂隙探球”才有进度；若期间失去水晶球所在的星系（astral_planes.20 设置 has_lost_crystal_sphere），情境中止。
note.en: The two options of 15 each start a situation: study (→ the Crystal Rift, which can then be explored) or destroy (→ the sphere is shattered into materials). Both situations make no progress without the Rift Sphere technology; losing the sphere's system (astral_planes.20 sets has_lost_crystal_sphere) aborts them.

note.zh: 100星界丝缕、各500稀有水晶与奇异气体、“位面的和平”3600天及水晶球体碎片；排外或狂暴灭绝者另得凝聚力；不再有晶体裂隙。
note.en: 100 astral threads, 500 rare crystals, 500 exotic gases, Peace in This Dimension (3600 days) and crystal sphere fragments; xenophobes and homicidal empires gain unity. No Crystal Rift follows.

label.zh: 研究结束：晶体裂隙出现
label.en: The Study Is Over: the Crystal Rift appears

note.zh: 按球体上的指示布置气体与星界丝缕后，球体消失，在水晶球星系生成晶体裂隙（见《晶体裂隙》）。
note.en: After arranging gases and astral threads as the sphere's instructions say, the sphere vanishes and the Crystal Rift appears in the crystal sphere system (see “The Crystal Rift”).

astral_planes.30.zh: 奇怪的球体（尚无探球科技）
astral_planes.30.en: A Strange Sphere (no Rift Sphere yet)

notes.zh: 球体只送一次（全局标记 crystal_sphere_sent）。每年脉冲检查 astral_planes.10：游戏已过中期 1 年以上、至少一个国家完成 5 次裂隙探索；然后在已有“裂隙探球”且完成 ≥3 次探索的国家中，按每国的随机骰（裂隙世界起源减半，AI 加倍）与探索次数、游戏年数比较，取完成探索最多者；球体生成在其最靠近首都的、没有天然虫洞的己方星系（游牧帝国则在己方航站所在星系），10 天 + 随机 350 天后触发 15。
notes.en: The sphere is sent only once (global flag crystal_sphere_sent). The yearly pulse checks astral_planes.10: more than a year of mid-game has passed and at least one country has completed 5 rift explorations; among countries with the Rift Sphere technology and ≥3 completed explorations, a per-country random roll (halved for Riftworld, doubled for AI) is compared with the exploration count and game years, and the country with the most explorations is chosen; the sphere appears in its owned system closest to the capital without a natural wormhole (nomads: the system of an owned waystation), and 15 fires 10 days plus up to 350 random days later.

notes.zh: 若水晶球所在的星系易手（on_system_gained / on_system_lost），25 把球体交给新主人：已有“裂隙探球”则直接触发 15，否则触发 30，等研究出探球后由 35 再触发 15。
notes.en: If the sphere's system changes hands (on_system_gained / on_system_lost), 25 gives the sphere to the new owner: with the Rift Sphere technology it fires 15 at once, otherwise 30, and 35 fires 15 once the technology is researched.

scope.en: Checked astral_planes.10/15/20/25/30/35, both situations and astral_situation.1/5; the formerly separate trigger stories (10, 25, 35) are merged.
